info.title: タビキメワリ Business API
info.description: M0-A3 business API contract. Authentication, invite, internal task, upload transport, and event contracts are completed with the B lane.

201.description: Trip, OWNER member, and initial slots created atomically

200.description: Snapshot retaining the departed member for history
Snapshot retaining the removed member for history

201.description: Single-use invitation link; plaintext token is returned only here and must not be logged

200.description: Existing membership restored for the same UID

201.description: Membership created and token consumed atomically
Single-use recovery link; plaintext token is returned only here and must not be logged

200.description: Member reference moved to the authenticated Firebase UID and token consumed atomically
Complete ordered slots after an atomic reorder
Slot with candidate comparison and viewer-safe votes

201.description: Candidate persisted without waiting for URL metadata

200.description: Slot and plan item updated atomically
Adoption cleared when no confirmed expense blocks it
Resulting slots after an atomic split

204.description: DRAFT deleted; CONFIRMED expenses require an audited correction

201.description: Short-lived upload capability. The URL must never be logged.

post.description: Verifies the stored object's size and content type before marking the receipt UPLOADED.

201.description: Settlement draft with immutable calculation snapshot

firebaseBearer.description: Signature-verified Firebase ID token. Travel roles are loaded from trip_member, never trusted from client claims.

tasksServiceOidc.description: Only the configured Cloud Tasks service account and exact environment audience are accepted.

schedulerServiceOidc.description: Only the configured Cloud Scheduler service account and exact environment audience are accepted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reused for retries of the same logical operation. A reused key with a different request hash returns 409.

Location.description: Canonical URL of the created resource

Forbidden.description: Authenticated trip member lacks the required role

NotFound.description: Trip membership or nested resource ownership was not found; this response does not disclose another trip's resource

ValidationFailed.description: Syntactically valid request that violates field or business validation

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded without disclosing token validity

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller may retry

firebaseUid.description: UID from a signature-verified Firebase ID token

unvotedMemberIds.description: ACTIVE members who have not voted. Present for both NAMED and ANONYMOUS visibility.

namedVotes.description: Present only when visibility is NAMED. Never present for ANONYMOUS, including for OWNER and ORGANIZER.

finalAmount.description: Persisted deterministic burden; non-null for CONFIRMED expenses

hasReceipt.description: Must be true when creating a photo-only DRAFT; an upload is prepared after creation

current.description: Current safe response representation of the conflicted resource
